info.name: Coderr
info.description:
Full happy-path / unhappy-path test suite for the Coderr backend.

IMPORTANT: Run the whole collection top-to-bottom (Collection Runner), not individual requests in isolation. Later requests depend on environment variables (tokens, IDs) set by earlier ones. The 'cleanup' folder must run last, since 'unhappy path > Reviews > create_review_duplicate' still needs the review created in 'happy path' to exist.

exec: pm.test("Profile belongs to the business user", () => pm.expect(body.user).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('businessUserId'))));
